title: F08 · the_lie · Signed by Me
lines: He practised her signature eleven times.
She would never have to know.
At dinner she asked how school was.
Every time he passed the shelf that night, the little lamp seemed brighter.
At midnight he put the card on the kitchen counter, and woke her.
She looked at the marks. Then at the signature.
You got my S wrong, she said. And then she hugged him.
"You got my S wrong," she said. And then she hugged him.
The fall is small. Hiding it is what makes it heavy. That is sadhana.
